why.kpiShape: A KPI is one measure with no category breakdown.
why.needsTime: A line needs a time breakdown.
why.lineShape: A line is 1 to 4 measures over time, or one measure over time by one category.
why.areaShape: A stacked area is one measure over time by one category.
why.rateStacked: A rate or percentile is never stacked.
why.barShape: A bar is 1 to 3 measures by one breakdown, or one measure by two.
why.needsSeries: Stacked and grouped bars need two series: a second measure or a second breakdown.
why.donutShape: A donut is one measure by one category.
why.donutAdditive: A rate or percentile is never put in a donut.
why.heatmapShape: A heatmap is one measure by two breakdowns.
why.comboShape: A combo is one volume measure and one rate, by one breakdown.
